output.why: Increasing the COT/DOT waste water transfer pump capacity from 2 m3/hr to 5 m3/hr reduces the retention/emptying time of the 1 m3 upstream collection sump (E1C) from 30 minutes to 12 minutes, which may cause frequent pump cycling and affect NPSH/suction conditions. Additionally, the pump head, motor rating, and level switch setpoints are not specified in the tender documents (listed as 'As per System Requirements') and must be verified during detailed engineering.
